name: Barnaby Bruin
bio: Top hat, red coat, impeccable manners. Apologises before every headshot, and means it.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB (1.5M triangles), rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not Teddy (a plush toy): a bear in a striped red coat, waistcoat, ruff and top hat. Paws measure as closed blocks: `hands.curl` makes them mittens that close on the grip; at full size (22 cm) they sat 8 cm off the grip and stretched at the knuckle, so they are scaled to 0.7 with curl 1.2 (grip audit 9 to 3, flat: a mitten bends once). His coat's texture is cut into thousands of small islands (every cut that kept it stopped at 20.6-23k triangles, and even the careful cut scrambled it in places), so he is built with `surface: rebake` (2026-11-01): the full download cut to 17k with its seams closed, laid out afresh and its colour and normal maps painted from the download (docs/CHARACTERS.md). Replaced 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b, the owner's mapping) by "Bear Warrior" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used); it was built from Gentleman Bear T Pose.
